Home Defect Inspection (DLP)

Catch every defect before your Defect Liability Period expires.

New home ownersUnits under DLP
12Elements Checked
50+Defect Types
15+Tests & Tools
5,000+Units Inspected
14 photosResidential

After you collect your keys, the developer is obliged to rectify defects free of charge — but only during the DLP. Our registered surveyors inspect every room, surface and fitting, and document each defect with photos and exact locations so your claim cannot be disputed.

What's included

  • Full visual inspection of all rooms, walls, floors & ceilings
  • Hollow tile tapping test on all tiled surfaces
  • Doors, windows & fittings operation check
  • Plumbing, sanitary & drainage check
  • Electrical point functionality test
  • Moisture screening on wet areas

What you receive

  • Photo-tagged defect report (PDF)
  • Defect locations & severity listed
  • Submission-ready for your developer
